scenarios.purpose: End-to-end challenge demo with fatigue/recovery, data-quality artifact, missing SpO2, CO2 and radiation context, periodic lab data, offline operation and reconnect.
Demonstrate that artifact and missing data are visible and are not interpreted as health deterioration.
Shared environmental/cognitive timeline with an explicit non-causal CO2 guardrail.
Radiation dose-rate context with detector provenance and no biological risk score.
